CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (DNA detection) was met at 98.3%, and secondary efficacy endpoint (ORR) showed 35% response rate, which is clinically meaningful for melanoma. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: HSV-1 status affected DNA detection rates (97.5% vs 100%) and clearance patterns, but both subgroups showed target engagement. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design limits interpretation, but the high DNA detection rate and meaningful ORR support efficacy. Safety profile was manageable with 10% grade ≥3 treatment-related AEs.
